name: Escape The Lava🔥
desc:
🔥 Welcome to THE FLOOR IS LAVA! 🔥

Quick! The floor is turning into lava and rising fast. Can you escape?

🎮 Features:

- Survive the Lava: Jump and climb to stay safe.
- Unlock Cool Stuff: Earn coins to buy pets and gears
- Play with Friends: Have fun together and maybe even prank each other!
- Premium Reward: Recieve a reward for premium players

Tags: The Floor Is LAVA, Lava, Obby, Lava Survival
